# Validate a required grid-coordinate argument

```r
.validate_required_grid_argument(value, n, name, lines_name)
```

## Arguments

- `value`: Argument value.
- `n`: Expected argument length.
- `name`: Argument name used in error messages.
- `lines_name`: Name of the associated line-index argument.

## Returns

The validated argument.

## Description

Validate a required grid-coordinate argument
